initialization: All three variants start from the same root-trained force weights within each seed, now with force_field.roots_only=False. Fixed/scalar/collective mobility matrices are identical at initialization. Scalar controls uniform step adaptation; collective adds learned graph co-motion.
objective: Mean softplus of actual dimensionless augmented work plus100 times a smooth desired-graph distance penalty. Query every candidate, including chemical failures; this is a smooth training proxy, not an unbiased gradient of hard-support acceptance or a certified hard-target KL.
accounting: Four composition checks each score two source endpoints in both inversion orientations:16 raw calls.100 updates*4 candidates*2 orientations=800. Same selected source/direction/momentum streams for all three variants per seed. Every electronic condition is sent on each sequential oracle request.
interpretation: Rapid architecture/work-training experiment on existing32 FIT parents only. No evaluation or reserved states are fitted. Graph penalties are training-only and do not change the physical evaluation target. The first molecular pilot remains negative; no advantage or novelty follows from fitting this objective.
